About.name: Veronika
About.text_3: I work with React, Next.js, and TypeScript. For me, it’s not just code - it’s something I’m truly passionate about. I love seeing the result of my work: watching lines of code turn into a clean and elegant website always brings me joy. Thanks to my background in architecture, I pay special attention to detail and aesthetics. At the same time, I’m a determined person who doesn’t give up when things get tough. If there is a challenge - there is always a solution!
